apps.disagreement_reason: The human's 0 rests on the app looking old ('old CD-player interface'), which the rubric excludes. Nothing on either screen is cut off, overlapping, wrapped, broken or garbled. The one measurable item the inspector missed is borderline: white labels on light-blue tiles measure about 1.9:1 on the selected 'Sing' tile and about 2.7:1 on the other buttons, below 3:1 even for large text. The labels are about 28px and still readable, so this is minor. At most it moves the score from 2 to 1, never to 0. Other things you might notice are excluded: the dim logo is branding, the mirrored footer and card reflections are a design effect, and the slightly wide stretching (a 4:3 theme on a 1280x800 sandbox screen) comes from the sandbox.

defects.reason: Real mid-word break: 'Gottheim' / 'er' in the profile heading. But every letter is shown and the name still reads as Josh Gottheimer, so it is an ugly break rather than hidden or garbled content. Borderline, but minor fits better than major.
The Date column wraps every short date onto three lines ('Aug / 14, / 2026') in every row. The dates are still readable, so minor.
The Filing column wraps each date onto three lines, with the arrow on a fourth. The wrap alone is minor. The bigger problem in this column is its contrast, listed as missed.

image 2, top-right stat card: the value nearly touches the card's right border (about 11px of padding on the right vs about 24px on the left)

apps.disagreement_reason: The label 'taste' fits only loosely here. The human's 2 is the holistic impression of a clean, modern dark page, but the inspector's low score is not an error: its three defects are real and measurable. Where the inspector erred was in calling the name wrap major; it is minor, and minor defects alone would give 1. It also missed a bigger problem: the Filing links are dark navy on near-black, measured at 1.46:1, which makes the filing dates hard to read. That alone gives 0. One caveat: the table was caught mid-'Updating…' and is dimmed. Even so, the Filing text is far darker than the other dimmed text in the same rows (about 5.3:1), and undimmed I estimate it at only about 2.4:1. So the human overlooked real defects; this is not a case of the inspector inventing them.

defects.reason: The status pill is cut to 'Установка не...', so the user cannot tell what setup is incomplete. That is hidden content. It is also low contrast (orange on peach, about 1.96:1).
The bottom-right notice is clamped at 'Настройка...', which hides what appears to be the setup instruction. Hidden content, so major is reasonable.
The version string is pale grey on pale cyan, measured about 1.89:1. A version number is not text a user needs, so minor.

There is a real flaw here, but it is not tiny text: the count is about the same size as other captions in the app. What is measurable is low contrast (grey on lavender, about 1.89:1) and a short value wrapping onto two lines ('2 из 9' / 'проверок'). The kind should be low_contrast or bad_wrap.

defects.reason: The chart is not clipped. The leftmost green bar ends at x 503 and the pane divider is at x 490, a gap of about 13px. The small detached ticks at the bar ends are the chart's outer-ring style, not a cut.

The outer red arc ends at x 967 and the window edge is at x 980, the same 13px margin as on the left. The whole arc, including its thin outer ring, is drawn. The flat edge at y 320 is where a segment's angle starts, not a crop.

The text is not cut off. Its glyphs span y 641-648 with white rows below them down to y 651, and the string has no descenders. The real flaw at this spot is low contrast: light grey on white, about 1.84:1. It is listed as missed.
